# RhythmRaga Academy — School of Music & Arts

> Offline Music Academy located in GTB Nagar, North Delhi (near Delhi University North Campus & Hudson Lane).

## About RhythmRaga
RhythmRaga is an offline music institute offering in-person 1-on-1 and small batch training in Instrumental music (Guitar, Piano/Keyboard, Drums) and Vocal training (Classical, Western, Contemporary Singing) for beginners, kids, teenagers, college students, and adults.

## Key Information
- **Location**: Gate 4, GTB Nagar Metro Station, 2529 Basement (opposite Domino's, near McDonald's & Laxmi Dairy), North Delhi, Delhi 110009, India.
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Sunday: 11:00 AM – 9:00 PM IST.
- **Mode of Instruction**: 100% Offline / In-Person Studio Classes.
- **Phone / Call**: +91 87965 74448 / +91 81302 51057
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/918796574448
- **Official Website**: https://rhytthmraga.com
- **Free Studio Trial Booking**: https://rhytthmraga.com/book

## Courses Offered
1. **Guitar Classes**: Acoustic Guitar, Electric Guitar, Fingerstyle, Rhythm & Lead for complete beginners and intermediate players.
2. **Piano & Keyboard Lessons**: Western classical, chord progressions, reading sheet music, synthesizer and keyboard fundamentals.
3. **Drums & Percussion Training**: Acoustic drum kit training, rhythm timing, limb independence, rock, pop & funk grooves.
4. **Vocal & Singing Training**: Classical Indian vocals, Hindustani classical foundations, Western contemporary singing, pitch correction, breath support, and vocal range expansion.

## Nearby Landmarks & Metro Accessibility
- Direct 1-minute walk from **GTB Nagar Metro Station (Yellow Line, Gate 4)**.
- Close proximity to Delhi University North Campus colleges (Miranda House, SRCC, Hindu College, Hansraj College, KMC, St. Stephen's).
- Walking distance from Hudson Lane, Kingsway Camp, and Vijay Nagar.
- Accessible within 10–15 minutes from Model Town, Mukherjee Nagar, Kamla Nagar, Roop Nagar, Derawal Nagar, and Civil Lines.

## Free Trial Experience
Prospective students can reserve a free 30-minute in-person trial class to meet their mentor, tour the soundproof studio, and experience hands-on learning before enrolling.
